name: How do you handle waste disposal during jobsite cleanup in the Berkeley area?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle waste disposal during jobsite cleanup in the Berkeley area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Berkeley area, we manage waste disposal during jobsite cleanup by adhering to local regulations and environmental guidelines. This typically involves separating recyclable materials like wood, metal, and concrete from general construction debris. We utilize designated waste bins and work with licensed waste management companies for proper disposal and recycling. This approach helps minimize environmental impact and comply with local ordinances.
acceptedAnswer.description: We handle waste disposal in Berkeley by separating recyclables, using designated bins, and working with licensed waste management companies.
